title: gz-starter release history
description: What each tagged gz-starter (formerly skills-first-starter) release's configure wrote, generated from tags v0.1.0 to v0.13.0 by tools/build_release_history.py. Templates are raw text with {{...}} placeholders left in place.

releases.description: One entry per release tag, in version order.

revisions.description: Every commit reachable from v0.13.0 that has a release tag among its ancestors, mapped to the latest such tag (the tag itself for a tagged commit). Commits that predate v0.1.0 are absent and therefore not in the history.

managed_path.description: A repository-relative POSIX path, optionally prefixed by a marker and a colon. No marker: the whole file is managed and always written with the release's template. 'if-absent:' written only when the file did not exist, then project-owned. 'merged:' host configuration into which configure merged its marketplace and plugin entries while preserving other content. 'merged-if-exists:' used instead of the host's 'merged:' path when this file already existed (OpenCode opencode.jsonc). 'adr-local:' written only when the lock's adr_policy.mode is 'local'.

origin.description: ORIGIN written to the lock's starter.repository and the marketplace source.

marketplace.description: Native catalog name used in host configuration and plugin keys.

fragment_template.description: AGENTS.skills-first.md as read by configure (UTF-8, LF).

update_skill.description: Name of the managed update skill, or null before v0.6.0.

update_skill_template.description: The update skill's SKILL.md (UTF-8, LF), or null.

adr_placeholders.description: True when configure replaced {{ADR_POLICY_WORKING_SOURCE}} and {{ADR_POLICY_CANONICAL_URL}} in the fragment.

hosts.description: Hosts configure accepted, sorted. A lock without a host key means codex.

managed_paths.description: Per host, in configure's write order, every path configure wrote.

front_door_skill.description: Starter front-door skill written under .agents/skills (v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 only), or null.

front_door_skill_template.description: The front-door skill's SKILL.md (UTF-8, LF), or null.

agents_md_template.description: AGENTS.md text written when the project had none.

lock_keys.description: Top-level lock keys in write order; 'host' is written only for a host other than codex.

adr_policy_source.description: Starter path of the ADR policy recorded in the lock's adr_policy.source_path, or null before v0.10.0.

adr_policy_template.description: The ADR policy's exact text, copied byte for byte in local mode, or null.

adr_policy_url.description: Canonical policy URL with {ref} standing for the adopter's recorded revision, or null.
